stories.title: Flintshire roadworks round-up: what is closed and where this week
stories.summary: Drivers across Flintshire are facing road closures and temporary traffic lights at dozens of locations this week, with two Flint roads shut by National Grid until 20 July. stories.title: Mold firm Celtic Financial Planning achieves B Corp certification and donates to Hawarden, Northop and Mold clubs
stories.summary: A Mold-based financial planning firm has donated £7,500 to local charities, community groups and grassroots sports clubs since April 2025, according to its first environmental, social and governance (ESG) report. stories.title: Award-winning musical Hadestown announces Chester Storyhouse dates for 2027 tour
